title: Jump Game
statement: You start at index 0. `nums[i]` is the maximum forward jump length from i. Return true when index n - 1 is reachable.
hints: A BFS on indices is correct and uses a queue.
Greedy: track the farthest index reachable so far.
If the scan index ever passes that farthest index, you are stuck.

approaches.name: DFS or BFS
approaches.explanation: Visit each index once if you mark it.

approaches.name: Farthest reach
approaches.explanation: One integer summarizes every earlier jump.

editorial: Let reach be the largest index you can stand on. For each i from 0 while i <= reach, set reach = max(reach, i + nums[i]). If reach ever becomes at least n - 1, return true. If the loop ends because i walked past reach, a zero gap blocked every jump.

examples.explanation: One jump of 2 and then 3 reaches the end.
